description.en: Plays a full-screen movie file with an accompanying sound track, fading the given screens and BGM as configured, and waits for it to finish.
Base sound ID; "_<LG>" is appended to form the actual audio track name.
Whether to fade screen A for the movie.
Whether to fade screen B for the movie.
Whether to fade the BGM for the movie.
Optional fade-in duration in frames (defaults to 15.0).
Optional fade-out duration in frames (defaults to 15.0).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Play a cutscene movie with its accompanying audio track
PlayMovie("scene01", "a4m01a", false, false, false, EV_MOVIE_FADE_IN);
